name: photo-upload
title: Photo Upload
description: Photos from the five places people get them (pick, drag, paste, camera), made small and clean on the device, then handed to ONE function the app provides, `onUpload`. The component never opens a connection: it has no `fetch`, no `XMLHttpRequest`, no…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/photo-upload

Installed to `components/ui/patterns/photo-upload.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/patterns/photo-upload';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/photo-upload

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
